items.html: However, now it is not so, for each one is in its place, and it follows that the lower Eheyeh, which is in her three last ones, descends there, and the blood is always found in the source and Yesod of the woman, because it is in the secret of the posterior (Achoraim) of the GAT, and blood ascends in this way: Alef, Alef-Hei, Alef-Hei-Yud, Alef-Hei-Yud-Hei, and there, in the posterior, is the blood.
